title: Judge whether the proofless-cap story is already covered, then close only the gap
action: This is the feature's consolidated test cell, and it is the first cell in this repo to run under D4: its FIRST mandated step is a coverage judgment, not authoring. Do that step visibly and record it. The net behavior to cover is one story: a cap that recorded no proof is marked, a cap that recorded real proof is not, both close-door readers arm on the marker, a dropped test cell owes nothing yet hides nothing, and no bypass level passes any of it. Step 1 — read the suites and cite, by file:line, the nearest existing tests that already exercise each part of that story (test_cells.mjs's marker rows and negative controls; test_bee_cli.mjs's seam rows, generated door matrix, dropped-cell rows, and bypass rows). For each part write one line: covered, partly covered, or not covered, with the anchor. Step 2 — author ONLY what step 1 found uncovered, in the triad shape of D5: happy path, edge cases, error paths, at its smallest demonstrating size. Do not restate per-cell internals that the sibling cells already pin. Step 3 — if step 1 finds the story genuinely complete, that is a legitimate outcome: cap on running the relevant suites green and record 'already covered, no new rows' with the citations as the evidence. Per D4 a test cell that authors no test is NOT a defect; a test cell that authored rows nobody needed is the waste this feature exists to stop. Whichever way it lands, the recorded verify must be a real run with real output. This cell owns its regen chain — run the plugin skill-tree render, then the onboarding apply, then the release-manifest write, in that order, before capping.

truths: The coverage judgment is recorded with a file:line citation for every part of the net-behavior story
Any authored row closes a gap the judgment named, and no row duplicates coverage the judgment found
The recorded verify is a real run with real output, whichever way the judgment lands

artifacts.substantive: only the rows the coverage judgment found missing; unchanged if the judgment finds the story complete

key_links: the cap evidence carries the coverage judgment, so a later reader can see what was checked and why nothing more was written
prohibitions: Do not author rows that restate per-cell internals already pinned by wc-1, wc-2 or wc-2c
Do not cap with an asserted pass and no output
